overview: You read the Rose's bill before you left the Theatre. The title is Harry the Fifth. It names no author. You did not cross the river, and you did not treat the bill as a thing to attend.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the title, and did not start for the river.

assets.name: Harry the Fifth
assets.disposition: Read the Rose bill, Harry the Fifth
